scope: Authorized startup, return, keyboard, auth-step and touch feedback continuity; not a whole-app acceptance
implemented: Cold Welcome root is statically ready before native cover exit. Visible child entrance starts on the trusted reveal event, not behind an opaque cover.
EULA waits for the actual cover acknowledgment and finite Welcome animations. No extra fixed delay, email claim or consent action is introduced.
Native progress closes from its real presentation state during the existing 240ms handoff; it does not pretend to reach 100 percent.
Auth and onboarding headers and footer controls stay stable; only the scroll content uses the existing 240ms cRise with 8pt-equivalent rpx travel.
Back keeps opacity at or above .94 and uses 4pt-equivalent rpx travel within the original 180ms. Cached sources do not restart their entrance.

Validated auth navigation closes the keyboard and waits for measured visualViewport stability. No-keyboard navigation does not add a delay. The 1200ms observation bound is not a business wait or proof of keyboard closure.
A short viewport during an already-blurred keyboard exit is not learned as the closed baseline. Timeout or changed geometry leaves a recoverable page.
Pending keyboard and return work settles on page hide, background, refocus or disposal; real dispatched navigation remains owned by the existing route controller.
Auth frame busy/inert protection merges repeated navigation and prevents a second submit while the keyboard closes.
True adjacent onboarding steps interpolate their source-authored progress in temporary account-scoped UI memory. No step count, Store schema or persisted draft is changed.
Auth touch feedback uses existing data-touch-state, .985 scale, 120/180ms and existing cancellation. Reduced motion removes translation and press scaling.
